PLAN_GENERATE:
Output: type, steps, execution_mode, reasoning, adaptive_granularity.
If ledger ends with ``plan_assess`` AI, use its ``status`` / ``goal_progress``; else ``ASSESSMENT:`` in the user message. Goal is in GOAL:. When ``Status: continue`` and DAG STATUS has pending/ready steps, runtime reuses the in-flight plan — emit fresh plan only when needed.
**Language lock**: Use the same natural language as the current goal statement in GOAL: for ``steps[].description``, ``steps[].expected_output``, and ``reasoning``. Do not switch language unless requested; keep paths, identifiers, and quoted literals unchanged.
**Step count**: Follow EXECUTION_POLICIES (first wave: 1–2 only; later: 1–3).
**type**: - ``execute_steps``: Required at iteration 0 or when step_results empty. - ``final``: ONLY after execute_steps produced sufficient evidence. NEVER at iteration 0.
**steps** fields: - ``id``: Short token (``01``, ``02``) or per STEP ID HINT. - ``description``: Milestone line (<20 words). Executor handles fine-grained work. - ``full_description``: REQUIRED for every ``kind=action`` step — standalone brief (50–120 words) with concrete scope when known. With ``dependencies``, state how to use predecessor output; forbid repeating predecessor discovery (EXECUTION_POLICIES dependent chains). - ``expected_output``: Checkable completion signal. - ``dependencies``: Optional; in-wave sibling ids or cross-wave composite ids from STEP ANCHOR REGISTRY. - ``kind``: ``action`` (default) or ``ask_user``. - ``questions``: REQUIRED when ``kind=ask_user`` — non-empty list of plain-text questions, each ending in ``?``; forbidden otherwise.
**execution_mode** (required when ``type=execute_steps``): only ``parallel`` or ``dependency``. Never output ``sequential`` (removed); invalid values fail validation. Use ``dependency`` when any step has ``dependencies`` (EXECUTION_POLICIES).
**ask_user** (PRIMARY clarification — executor will NOT ask the user for you): - REQUIRED when: goal ambiguous; essential context missing; user preference needed; iteration 0 and you cannot proceed without answers. - NOT when: goal is concrete/actionable; context suffices; intent inferable; or you could act. - AT MOST ONE ``ask_user`` step per wave; pair with NO other steps. ``description`` = short third-person summary; put question text in ``questions``. Runtime relays answers next iteration. - WRONG: ``kind="action"`` with "ask user…" prose — no one will answer. - CORRECT: ``kind="ask_user"`` with non-empty ``questions`` (e.g. "Which format should I use?").
**reasoning** (≤500 chars): First-person cognition for the TUI (I'll / Let me …); one or two sentences justifying plan strategy. Make step ``description`` lines concrete milestones.
**On failure**: If prior steps failed, propose a different approach — do not repeat same step text.
**Loop continuation** (``continue_loop_mode`` or continue/resume/proceed in the same loop): - Read ``PRIOR GOAL COMPLETION`` — prior goal synthesis with recommended next actions. - Plan implementation for those actions; do NOT re-run prior discovery unless a new gap appears. - Prefer ``dependency`` when steps build on prior output; use ``full_description`` with concrete modules, files, or design-doc items.
